description: Change an invoice. Required: invoice_id. Optional: lines, title, recipient, address, intro, outro, payment_note, issued_on, due_days, status. Totals are always recomputed from the lines. Changing the lines of an invoice that has left the house needs force=true — cancelling and issuing a new one is usually correct.

force.description: true allows line changes on an invoice that was already sent

intro.description: Introductory text printed above the positions

invoice_id.description: ID of the invoice to change

lines.description: New positions; replaces the existing lines of the invoice

outro.description: Closing text printed below the positions

payment_note.description: Payment information block (e.g. IBAN) printed on the invoice

name: update_invoice
